recognize_zh: 骨髓切片左側與下方可見成群、成片的大型異型漿細胞：細胞質豐富偏雙嗜性、核偏心、核仁明顯或染色質呈車輪狀，與右上方正常的紅血球系及顆粒球系前驅細胞混雜，符合多發性骨髓瘤的局部浸潤。
features: Clusters and small sheets of atypical plasma cells, most prominent in the left and lower portions of the core
Plasma cells medium-to-large with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei
Nuclei with vesicular or clock-face chromatin, some with distinct nucleoli and occasional binucleation
Residual normal hematopoiesis (erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei, granulocytes) interspersed, especially upper right
Bony trabecula at the bottom edge; scattered fat spaces
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows cellular marrow in which clusters and small sheets of atypical plasma cells are interspersed among residual normal hematopoietic elements, most prominent in the left and lower portions of the section adjacent to a bony trabecula. The plasma cells are medium to large with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, variably vesicular chromatin and occasional prominent nucleoli or binucleation. Erythroid and granulocytic precursors remain in the intervening areas. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma with a focal/interstitial pattern; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are recommended to quantify and confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, scattered singly or around vessels and polytypic, not forming clusters of atypical nucleolated cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive glands or nests with desmoplasia and is keratin positive, whereas these discohesive eccentric-nucleus cells would be CD138+ and light-chain restricted.
Erythroid precursors have round central nuclei, deeply basophilic scant cytoplasm and form colonies, lacking the eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm of plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD20/PAX5 positive with less abundant cytoplasm; immunostains separate them from CD138+ CD20- myeloma cells.
